payload.title: The consensus evidence gate grades the agreeing judges while the row publishes only the closing set, so under calibration enforce an uncalibrated agreeing judge's missing ref still escalates a group the row does not speak for, and the sibling admissibility gate already uses closing.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1225-1233 (the docstring says the caller passes the judges the consensus row speaks for)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1422-1433 (under enforce the closing set is the calibrated subset of the agreeing judges)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1464 (_has_unverifiable_evidence is called with agreeing, not closing)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1470 (the sibling admissibility gate _has_inadmissible_evidence is called with closing)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1572 (the published evidence_refs are the union over closing)
payload.rule_violated: JJ-1: everything the consensus row asserts about itself, evidence included, is scoped to the judges it speaks for; two sibling gates must use one scope.
payload.notes: Under calibration_gate enforce, an agreeing judge that is not calibrated is left out of closing, and the row's evidence_refs come from closing only. If that judge's ref is missing, _has_unverifiable_evidence(agreeing, ...) still escalates the group as evidence_not_repo_verified although the row neither publishes nor depends on that ref; the group goes owed to the arbiter and, with that judge's row still among agreeing, never settles, which is the stuck-owed result B1 fixed for the default scope. The corrective notes call agreeing the conservative reading and left it. Reachable only when the effective calibration gate is enforce, which needs calibrated judges (the PR body states ARIA currently has none). Close condition: _has_unverifiable_evidence is called with closing (or the choice of agreeing is stated and pinned), its docstring names the set it takes, and a test under calibration_gate enforce with an uncalibrated agreeing judge citing a missing ref asserts the group settles on the calibrated closing set without evidence_not_repo_verified, while a calibrated judge's missing ref still escalates. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
